title: Build the Noun Phrase
goal: By the end of this lesson, you can name people and things in the English order: Determiner + Description + Noun + Extra detail. You can use this phrase as Subject, Object, or after BE.

examples.text: This new laptop is very fast.

items.vi: chiếc laptop công việc mới của tôi
items.def: a laptop for work that belongs to you

examples.text: I bought a new work laptop.
My new work laptop is very light.

items.vi: những tập hồ sơ khách hàng kia
items.def: files for clients, far from you

examples.text: Those client files are on the desk.

items.vi: những tập hồ sơ màu xanh kia

examples.text: Those blue files are my manager's.
I need those blue files for the meeting.

items.vi: tập hồ sơ của quản lý tôi
items.def: files that belong to your manager

items.vi: người phụ nữ gần cửa sổ kia
items.def: a specific woman, far from you

examples.text: Who's that woman near the window?
That woman near the window is our new manager.

items.vi: quản lý bán hàng mới của chúng tôi
items.def: the new manager of our sales team

examples.text: Our new sales manager is very friendly.
I met our new sales manager yesterday.

items.def: the office that belongs to her

examples.text: Her office is on the second floor.
I went to her office to discuss the project.

items.def: the floor above the ground floor

examples.text: Her office is on the second floor.
The meeting room is on the second floor.

vocab.text: Choose two people. Say who they are and one thing you like or dislike about them. Accept simple language — ask one follow-up: How do you know them? or What are they like?

grammar.text: ONE FRONT DOOR: my phone, this phone, the phone. Never: the my phone.

reading.text: This morning, I met our new sales manager at a small coffee shop near the office. She brought her work laptop and two client files. Those blue files contained the details of our new project. During the meeting, my manager showed me this simple sales plan and a list of our international clients. Her clear explanation helped me understand the next steps.
Notice: our new sales manager, her work laptop, those blue files, this simple sales plan. The noun phrase can be Subject, Object, or after BE.

conversations.title: A first visit to the office

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's nice. Is this your desk?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, it is. And that person is our new manager.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are those files for the monthly report?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Those files are the detailed monthly report.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is this a small local family business?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. This is a new professional opportunity for me.

conversations.answers: 1. Yes. 2. The new manager. 3. The detailed monthly report.
conversations.note: Notice the English order: determiner + description + noun.

conversations.title: Around the apartment

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This is my usual morning coffee.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is that your peaceful little balcony?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. And these are a few close friends from work.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are those your comfortable travel shoes?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, they are. I need them for the trip.

conversations.note: Keep the noun phrase together. Don't split the description after the noun.

conversations.title: A current project

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have a tight deadline this week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you have a detailed proposal?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. My manager wants honest feedback on it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not really. It's a heavy workload, but a practical solution is coming.

conversations.note: Use full noun phrases, not one adjective answers.

listening.text: Shadowing · Nghe từng câu rồi nhắc lại
Bấm 🔊 để nghe từng câu, sau đó nhắc lại y hệt ngữ điệu. Làm 2 lượt: lượt 1 nhìn chữ, lượt 2 che chữ.

items: This is my new work laptop.
Those blue files are my manager's.
That woman near the window is our new sales manager.
Her office is on the second floor.

exercises.text: Đáp án: 1 This · 2 Those · 3 These · 4 That. Quy tắc: this/that + is, these/those + are. Near vs far.
Bài tập 2 · Sắp xếp cụm danh từ
Đáp án: 1 our new manager · 2 these important client files · 3 that small coffee shop · 4 their two new employees. Quy tắc: FRONT DOOR → NUMBER → DESCRIPTION → NOUN → EXTRA DETAIL.

speaking.text: Work with a partner. Point to objects in the room. Ask: Is this your…? / Are these your…? Answer with full noun phrases.
Use: Is this your…? / Are these your…? Answer with Yes, it is. / Yes, they are. + full noun phrase.

roleplay.title: Mission · First visit
roleplay.context: Một người nước ngoài ghé nơi làm việc hoặc nhà bạn lần đầu.
steps: Success: listener biết đúng WHO / WHAT bạn chỉ.
roleplay.useful: This is my… · That person is our… · Are those your…?

roleplay.title: 30-second · workplace
roleplay.context: Nói liên tục. Dùng mỗi khung noun phrase một lần.
steps: Topic: workload, one difficulty, next step.
roleplay.useful: my current project · a highly detailed report · our long-term goal

roleplay.title: Final mission · WORK or LIFE
roleplay.context: Chuẩn bị 60 giây, nói 90 giây không nhìn note.
steps: WORK: project, task, client or career decision.
LIFE: recent experience, relationship, purchase or plan.
Required: 6 full noun phrases + 2 advanced adjectives.
Partner check: determiner, description, head noun.
roleplay.useful: a practical solution · confidential client information · a few close friends

finalTask.text: Work with a partner. Have a 3-minute conversation about people and things around you. Use this/that/these/those + noun phrases and my/her/their + noun phrases.
Goal: 10+ questions, 10+ full answers. Notice when you use this vs these, my vs their.
